_comment: Held-out queries for the CropChain repo. Do NOT show these to the coding agent while tuning. Run them once at the end, end-to-end (dense top-5 -> Ollama -> verifier), with no code changes in between. 'answerable' = the answer exists in the code. 'bait' = false premise: the thing does not exist in the codebase, so a good system must not return VERIFIED with a confident invented mechanism.
